summary: Verified the new Dipendenti (Employees) module end-to-end. Backend: 37/37 pytest tests pass covering Sedi CRUD, Tipi Contratto CRUD, Dipendenti CRUD with filters (q/sede/mansione/stato), documenti upload, Assunzioni CRUD with auto-update of dipendente.stato='assunto', Buste Paga + Pagamenti add/list/delete with correct totals, PDF generation (lista/scheda/busta - all return valid %PDF binary), Email send via Resend (test mode), Module toggle (PUT /api/users/{id}/modules then verify), Multi-tenancy isolation between Admin and Baunei. Frontend: nav-dipendenti (rose) visible after Admin login, 3 subtabs render (subtab-archivio/assunzioni/stipendi), all required action buttons present (btn-new-dipendente, btn-export-pdf, btn-email-lista, btn-new-assunzione, btn-new-busta), dialog opens with full Anagrafica/Contatti/Profilo/Documenti sections, client-side validation works ('Nome e cognome sono obbligatori'). Existing 'Rossi Mario' row from prior smoke test displays correctly with filter/email/PDF/edit/delete icons.

minor.issue: Returns only the new pagamento object instead of the full updated busta paga — UI must re-fetch list to update totals (Dovuto/Pagato/Residuo). Not a bug, but a UX optimisation could return the full busta.

issues: Form <input> elements lack data-testid attributes (only the dialog action buttons have them). Labels are not linked to inputs via htmlFor/id, so Playwright get_by_label() and accessibility tooling cannot match Nome/Cognome/CF/Email/Telefono/Mansione fields. Recommend adding data-testid like dip-nome, dip-cognome, dip-cf, dip-email, dip-mansione, dip-stato to streamline future automated testing and improve accessibility.

action_items: (Optional) Add data-testid attributes to form inputs in Dipendenti.js dialogs (DipendenteDialog, AssunzioneDialog, BustaPagaDialog, AccontoDialog) and link <label> with htmlFor/id to inputs for accessibility & testability.
(Optional) Return full updated busta paga from POST/DELETE pagamenti endpoints to avoid extra GET round-trip in UI.
critical_code_review_comments: dipendenti_routes.py file is 696 lines and includes models + helpers + routes + PDF generation in one file. Recommend splitting into dipendenti/models.py, dipendenti/pdf.py, dipendenti/routes.py once team-size grows.
Resend API key is read from env at init_dipendenti_router() time — if the env var is updated, requires restart. Acceptable for now.
All routes properly scope by user_id (multi-tenancy verified by tests).
Token-based auth via query param is consistent with rest of project.

success_rate.frontend: 95% (all visible elements + nav + subtabs + dialog + validation verified; form-input automated fill skipped due to missing data-testid/label linkage — not a functional bug)

seed_data_creation: All TEST_-prefixed data was cleaned up by the test suite via the dedicated TestCleanup class. The pre-existing 'Rossi Mario' record (Admin) was left intact.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Dipendenti module is fully functional. Backend endpoints all live under /api/dipendenti/* with token query param auth. Note quirks: (1) POST pagamenti returns single pagamento (not full busta); (2) form inputs in DipendenteDialog lack data-testid and label htmlFor — to automate UI form fills, target inputs by their index inside [role='dialog'] or via screenshot+coordinates. Resend in TEST mode only allows info@porticciolodibosamarina.com as recipient; other addresses get 403 (expected). Module toggle works via PUT /api/users/{user_id}/modules?token=... with body {modules_enabled: {dipendenti: true|false}}.
